newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN INTERBANK LEU CLOSES FLAT VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN INTERBANK LEU CLOSES FLAT VS DLR.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Romania's leu ended Thursday pinned at 3,495/15 to the dollar, unchanged over the past two days, on an interbank market struggling to cope with hard currency shortages.
* Interbank operators said they were trying to get volumes from trading in other currencies, whose quotes offered better leu-dollar prices of up to 4,100.
* Prices oscillated on the retail market near 4,200.
* Operators said the money market stayed stagnant and overliquid, with one-week prices near 42 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
